mechanism_narrative: The sharp rebound in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES from t-1w to t-0w marks a recovery in commuting and footfall. That should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as more trips combine work and shopping activity.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -48.6 to -34.1 while WORKPLACES rose from -46.4 to -23.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean despite concurrent increases in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES for the next four weeks, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and TRANSIT stays deeply negative, people substitute home-based activity for discretionary outings. This should depress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks relative to the recent four-week mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +10 while TRANSIT remains below -30
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 12.1 at t-0w while TRANSIT was -34.1
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 and TRANSIT stays below -30, the substitution mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A continued improvement in GROCERY_PHARM after a prior dip signals renewed local errand traffic and neighborhood circulation. That spillover should modestly raise RETAIL_REC over the next one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -4.1 to -0.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM turns upward, the spillover hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in PARKS relative to the preceding week indicates weather- or leisure-favorable conditions that shift outing time toward mixed-purpose trips. That should support higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 5 points from the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -21.1 at t-2w to -11.9 at t-1w before easing to -17.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls during the next 28 days after PARKS rises by at least 5 points, the weather/leisure spillover fails.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates renewed restriction pressure or employer pullback. That should reduce discretionary shopping trips and push RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:Both series remain materially negative at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days after two consecutive weekly drops in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, the restriction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A large gap between RESIDENTIAL and WORKPLACES shows more time spent at home than at offices. That home-centric pattern should continue to suppress retail visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds WORKPLACES by at least 30 points
evidence_refs: fact:At t-0w RESIDENTIAL is 12.1 and WORKPLACES is -23.1
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days while RESIDENTIAL exceeds WORKPLACES by at least 30 points, the home-stay suppression hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT recovers from the current trough, the resulting access improvement should translate into more retail and recreation trips within one week. The mechanism is strongest when TRANSIT moves back toward baseline after being below -30.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its prior week after being below -30
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -48.6 at t-1w to -34.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses upward from below -30, the access-recovery mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES also remain depressed signals broad suppression of outside activity, not just shopping displacement. That broad contraction should keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both fall below their prior-week levels while TRANSIT stays below -30 and WORKPLACES stays below -20
evidence_refs: fact:At t-0w GROCERY_PHARM is -0.3, PARKS is -17.4, TRANSIT is -34.1, and WORKPLACES is -23.1
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite simultaneous weakness in grocery, parks, transit, and workplaces, the broad-suppression hypothesis is rejected.
